newsitem.title: USA: Arrow Air names CIAC, Inc agent for US Midwest.
newsitem.headline: Arrow Air names CIAC, Inc agent for US Midwest.

text.p: US all-cargo carrier Arrow Air said it has named CIAC, Inc of Minneapolis as its sales and marketing agent for 13 midwestern US states.
Arrow also said it has engaged Forward Air, a division of LandAir Services Inc., to provide road feeder services between major cities in the 13 states and the airline's Atlanta and Miami gateways.
CIAC field agents will maintain direct contact with customers while CIAC's customer service centre in Minneapolis will be responsible for cargo reservations and flight forwarding details, Arrow said.
LandAir terminals in the midwest and Ohio Valley cities will be used for drop-off and pickup points for cargo. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
